phases.description: NAOMI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still

questions.question: 0-0.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - NAOMI looks at HOLLIS?
0.5-4.7s ACTION: does this happen on screen - NAOMI speaks to HOLLIS calmly?
4.7-6s HOLD: does this happen on screen - NAOMI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): NAOMI speaks to HOLLIS
NAOMI: does the face/body read as calm, exact (restrained)? Must NOT read as: arrogance.
Line 116 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: NAOMI: Nobody is supposed to tell you. That's what sealed means, Sergeant.
NAOMI sounds like the voice bible: calm, even female voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC01_g20: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed on the counter, red seal up; the ledger: lying open on the counter, pages facing HOLLIS, away from the camera.

Last frame matches state SC01_g21: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed on the counter, red seal up; the ledger: lying open on the counter, pages facing HOLLIS, away from the camera.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Line 116: does NAOMI clearly speak to HOLLIS (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where HOLLIS stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do NAOMI's eyes go just past the lens to frame-right?
Does NAOMI look at HOLLIS and never into the lens?
Do ELI and HOLLIS stay on their own sides (frosted-glass hallway door / counter, staff side and archive shelves) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look.
